what: get_call_run called with the argument name Ringdown used to send, call_id
source: shape observed against the live MCP endpoint on 2026-08-20, for a call placed over REST. The identifier the tool quotes back was written for this repository; the surrounding text is the validation library's own, which is the finding
unobserved: nothing elided; this is the whole JSON-RPC envelope, down to the call id quoted back inside the validation error, which is a fictional identifier here
why_it_matters: the tool takes run_id and rejects call_id outright, so the request Ringdown sent could never have been answered. It arrives as HTTP 200 with result.isError true and no JSON-RPC error key, so a parser that only looks for an error envelope reads it as a successful result
